## Config Validation Tests

Run `node tests/validate-config.js` — 688 unit tests covering:
- Package configuration integrity (ids, names, install arrays)
- Framework-specific package filtering
- Env var structure validation
- ESLint framework-specific installs (`eslint-config-next` only for Next.js)
- Template rendering for Next.js + Supabase, Next.js and TanStack + plain Postgres, TanStack + Convex, Next.js + SQLite (Turso), and TanStack + SQLite (Self-hosted) combinations
- Database group structure and provider configs
- Testing group structure and Vitest scaffold templates (config, setup file, e2e exclusion with Playwright)
- API layer group (oRPC/tRPC), Convex skip condition, per-framework scaffold files, and React Query-dependent output
- Package managers (npm, pnpm, Yarn 1/2+, Bun): detection, prompt choices, install / dlx / exec commands, `{pm:*}` tokens, and per-package-manager docs
- Effect (v4): config, scaffolds per framework, v3-only API names kept out
- Phased workflow (light, gated, none): prompt, files per choice, gate scripts, every workflow template rendered across stacks with no leftovers, skill frontmatter, stack-specific checklist lines, no source-app names
- Selection: installs and env vars per framework, answer-dependent guidance, choices with requirements (shown disabled with the reason)
- MCP server: v2 SDK, router-generated vs standalone tools, auth guard, docs
- Background jobs: pg-boss needs Postgres, files and scripts per provider and framework, the one pg-boss module
- Analytics & Monitoring: PostHog/Sentry per framework, one shared browser entry, every combination rendered, the config edits (idempotent, with manual-step fallback)
- File uploads: UploadThing disabled next to Effect v4, R2 presigning rules, Tailwind v4 styles edit
- Review fixes: job providers install `zod`, the MCP endpoint and upload auth stubs refuse requests in production without auth, `.env.example` comments unescaped, docs and workflow files still generated when no package is selected
- Project fix-ups: Next.js's AGENTS.md rules block kept, CLAUDE.md importing it, shadcn's generated files ignored by ESLint, shadcn's init per framework (`-d` on Next.js, the `start` template on TanStack), `@/*` moved ahead of TanStack's `#/*` alias
